appDescription: An in-car air quality assistant that checks outdoor fine dust at the vehicle's location and protects cabin air by controlling windows, air recirculation and the air purifier.

function.name: SET_AIR_RECIRCULATION
function.description: Turn the cabin air recirculation mode on or off, and also turn on the air purifier when outdoor fine dust is bad.

enabled.description: True to turn air recirculation on, false to turn it off and bring in outside air.

function.name: PROTECT_CABIN_AIR
function.description: Close all side windows and turn on air recirculation and the air purifier to keep outdoor fine dust out of the cabin.

function.name: GET_OUTDOOR_AIR_QUALITY
function.description: Get the current outdoor fine dust grade and PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations at the vehicle's current location.
